entities.name: Joaquín Francisco Pacheco y Gutiérrez-Calderón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Joaquín Francisco Pacheco y Gutiérrez-Calderón also known as El Pontífice, was a Spanish politician and writer who served as Prime Minister of Spain in 1847 and held other important offices such as Minister of State. He was also the 3rd Attorney General of Spain.
